limitations: Pressure-loading contribution only; not total cavitation noise or resolved bubble-collapse sound.
Ideal infinite-span 2D Pa, not finite-turbine sound or perceived loudness; loading is N/m.
Common homogeneous-water propagation c0; no vapour refraction/scattering or acoustic mean flow.
Coherent periodic-Hann bin RMS and selected-bin periodic synthesis; not PSD or causal arrivals.
Primary startup exclusion is not stationarity; no resolved CFD bandwidth or physical validation.
Late window is estimator/window sensitivity, not an ensemble uncertainty or convergence proof.
ON-minus-OFF is a contrast between outputs, not an independently isolated cavitation source.
Exact zero levels/deltas are null with status; no artificial pressure floor or epsilon gain.
